title: ranunculus auricomus subsp. pseudopsis
intro: Ranunculus auricomus subsp. pseudopsis, commonly known as False Meadow Buttercup, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antiseptic and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of False Meadow Buttercup include its ability to treat wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, with therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
